(window.raid.fresh(), window.raid.start(11, 0), window.raid.skip(1.2), 'a new member, first pick')
'1 first room, nudge up, pointing: ' + (document.querySelector('.raid-card') ? 'card up' : 'NO CARD')
'2 after a click on it: ' + (document.querySelector('.raid-card.pinned') ? 'card kept' : 'NO CARD')
'3 clicked again, pointer still on it: ' + (document.querySelector('.raid-card.pinned') ? 'STILL KEPT' : document.querySelector('.raid-card') ? 'card up, not kept' : 'NO CARD')

(()=>{const b=document.getElementById('bottom').getBoundingClientRect().top; window.raid.offer(0,'apothecary'); window.raid.offer(1,'hearthcat'); window.raid.acorns(40); return '   the stall changes: bottom ' + b + ' -> ' + document.getElementById('bottom').getBoundingClientRect().top})()
'4 the stall busy while pointing: ' + (document.querySelector('.raid-card') ? 'card up' : 'NO CARD')

(()=>{const chip=document.querySelector('#traits .trait'); window.__chip=chip; const before=[...document.querySelectorAll('#traits .trait')].map(c=>c.textContent).join(' '); window.raid.plan(); return '   the bot fields more under the pointer: ' + before + ' -> ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('#traits .trait')].map(c=>c.textContent).join(' ')})()

'5 the strip redrawn while pointing: ' + (document.querySelector('.raid-card') ? 'card up' : 'NO CARD') + (document.querySelector('#traits [data-trait="' + window.__chip.dataset.trait + '"]') === window.__chip ? ', same chip' : ', CHIP REPLACED')
'6 just after a drag: ' + (document.querySelector('.raid-card') ? 'card up' : 'NO CARD')
'7 pointer gone: ' + (document.querySelector('.raid-card') ? 'CARD LEFT UP' : 'no card') + (document.body.classList.contains('trait-lit') ? ', STILL LIT' : ', nothing lit')
